About these 18 rides

They ride on 6 days of the week; Saturday has the most, with 7; only Friday has none. The earliest start is The Morning Ride (TMR) at 6:30 am; the latest is Alviso Noon Ride at 12:00 pm. The group waits for everyone on 5 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. There are 2 rides made for women, trans and femme riders. They run 14 every week, 2 once a month and 2 on dates posted one at a time. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Nov 9, 2026.
